facts.fact: The Somalia Federal Ministry of Health poster says DHIS2 functions as the national HMIS for aggregate reporting in Somalia.

The poster says RAAD (BAMNI), the national primary-care electronic health record deployed in 111 facilities across six states, automatically generates DHIS2-compliant aggregate reports from routine care records.
The poster says reporting completeness improved from 85% to 96% and timeliness from up to 15 days to same-day submission with RAAD-DHIS2 reporting in 111 public primary healthcare facilities.
